name: Dwarf satellites vs screened law
data: E3's clean primary sample of Milky Way / M31 dwarf satellites (45 canonical, 46 alt systems; Arroyo free-f binaries, Upsilon_V = 2, E-W estimator). Statistic: bootstrap median over systems of log10(g_obs/g_pred). v3 = stiffened AQUAL mu = x/(1+x) solved for each satellite as a Plummer sphere in its host's uniform field.
picture: Left: the median gap (dex) after each modelling step, both footings with bootstrap sd; the red line at 0 is 'data = prediction'. The shaded steps are v3 readings (L* floor, L* 90 pc) and U1's dust-free hosted case. Right: per satellite (canonical) the observed boost over Newton (dark dots) and v3's predicted boost (open red circles) against the host field x_e, joined by grey lines.
why: Isolated, the law leaves the satellites about +0.55 dex short; putting them in their host's field (the EFE that v3's AQUAL has) pulls the prediction toward Newton and the gap grows to +1.33 / +1.30 dex at the L* floor (9.0 / 8.8 sd), more at L* = 90 pc. The frozen FAIL line (gap >= 3 sd) is met on both footings, also for the worst-clean data. U1's theorem T3 says a hosted system that falls with its host carries no held dust, so the satellites would be dust-free and sit +2.00 / +1.99 dex above: STRUCTURAL. Each satellite is a spherical Plummer in a uniform field (no tides, no non-equilibrium).

name: Cluster cores (326 eRASS1)
data: Stacked tangential shear (ΔΣ) of 326 eRASS1 clusters from raw KiDS sources (21.3 million rows), in INNER / MID / OUTER radial apertures. v3 prediction: AQUAL mu = x/(1+x) on the clusters' baryons (eRASS1 gas, stars), native h 0.672 and 0.686, catalogue miscentring. A = measured / predicted.
picture: Left: A in the three apertures for both footings (dark = canonical, brown = alt), three primary cells each with error bars; crosses are the corner most favourable to the law; red line A = 1 is the law's prediction. Right: the Z of the MID (core) excess in every rebuild (F1, X11 all sources, X13 corrected for the size-split selection), with the 3σ line.
why: The core (MID) shear sits 1.5–1.9 times above what the law gives on the clusters' baryons, at Z 4.1–6.2 on every rebuild and both footings, while OUTER is close to 1: a shape problem, not an amplitude knob. Even the corner most favourable to the law (stars f* 0.30, gas +1σ, deep-X-ray gas factor, X-COP shape) leaves MID 1.23–1.37 and pushes OUTER below 1. X13 showed X11's source-size trend was a shear selection of the split, so the excess stands. S4: no allowed μ_K (v3's dust mass term) fixes it; X9: MOG fails too. Inherited inputs: eRASS1 R500 and distances use flat ΛCDM (70, 0.3), bracketed in F1.

name: Coma ultra-diffuse galaxies
data: CFG933's 9 admitted Coma ultra-diffuse galaxies (stellar velocity dispersions σ_obs, M★, R_e). Statistic E = 2 ln(σ_obs/σ_pred), unweighted mean ⟨E⟩, systematics from CFG948's recipe rerun on the v3 prediction. v3: stiffened AQUAL solved in Coma's measured hydrostatic field (β-model) at the mean 3-D and projected distances.
picture: Left: E per galaxy (canonical) with error bars, against the isolated law (open grey) and against v3 in Coma's field (dark); red line E = 0 is the prediction. Right: z_sys of ⟨E⟩ for each reading, both footings, with the frozen FAIL line at 3.
why: Isolated, the UDGs sit only 1.6 / 1.4σ above the law. But v3 has an external-field effect, and Coma's measured field (x_e ≈ 0.50–1.06 a0) pushes the prediction toward Newton, so all 9 sit above it: ⟨E⟩ +2.58 / +2.48 ln (+1.12 / +1.08 dex), z_sys 4.3 / 4.1, and still 3.4–3.6 with the field halved. Screening is irrelevant here. U1's theorem T3 (held dust is weightless in its host) makes it worse: +1.41 dex, z_sys 5.4. The fail assumes equilibrium in the current field; a UDG far out of equilibrium would escape it.

name: Red (early-type) lenses
data: KiDS galaxy-galaxy lensing of the record's 181,477 isolated lenses (B21 points in CFG829's low-g window, g_bar 10^-13.3 to 10^-11.9 m/s², 6 points), split by colour. v3 is forward-modelled as 4GΔΣ of F2's AQUAL solution with inventory baryons, hot CGM 0.5 M★, and the host field at three levels. A = data / v3.
picture: Red-lens amplitude A for three baryon readings (inventory only; +0.123 dex from CFG667; +0.123 dex plus the IMF α–σ posit), at three host-field levels, both footings, with error bars. Red line A = 1 is v3. The blue-lens A at the primary field is quoted for comparison.
why: On the stellar inventory alone, red lenses lens 1.32 / 1.20 times more than v3 predicts (5.0σ canonical, 3.5σ alt by the README), while blue lenses are consistent. The excess is removed only by two declared posits: CFG667's +0.123 dex extra baryons and a bottom-heavy IMF that scales with σ (CFG926), which bring A to 1.02 / 0.93. So the tile is conditional on those posits; with M★ −0.2 dex the red tile fails on canonical even with the IMF. The external field barely matters in this window except at the maximum field. The μ_K²ψ term is not included.

name: One selector for the family
data: T1 scales v3's host field by one diagnostic number ε (ε = 1 is v3, ε = 0 no external-field effect) and re-runs each member through its own lane's solver: S1's satellites and Coma UDGs, P2's GAMA spectroscopic isolated-galaxy lensing, D10's outer globulars. Selector lanes J1 (potential depth), K1 (braneworld Weyl fluid) and M2 (K1 + L* screening) are cited from their READMEs.
picture: Left: each dataset's 95 % interval in ε, both footings (open circle = best ε; 1.5 is the scan edge); the red line is v3 at ε = 1. Right: the satellites' median gap against ε for both footings; it never reaches the red zero line.
why: A single selector would have to explain why satellites, Coma UDGs and cluster cores sit above v3 while other systems do not. Measured as one EFE strength, the data disagree with each other: Coma wants ε ≤ 0.21 / 0.24, P2 lensing wants ε ≥ 0.67 / 0.81, and the satellites fail at every ε (still +0.91 / +0.89 dex at ε = 0). The one-ε consistency test gives p = 0.023 / 0.014, just above the frozen INCONSISTENT line (0.01). The potential-depth selector J1, the braneworld fluid K1 and its screened version M2 all fail their frozen rules. The family's membership still has to be re-derived after R1/R2/R6, so the tile stays open.
